# Test Texts Metadata

This directory contains curated text samples for testing the humanizer's detection capabilities.

## Directory Structure

```
fixtures/
├── human/                 # Text written by humans
│   ├── airfryer-opinion-es.txt
│   ├── docs-opinion-en.txt
│   ├── dog-tweet-es.txt
│   ├── office-migration-en.txt
│   ├── prod-bug-en.txt
│   └── social-media-fatigue-es.txt
│
└── ai/                    # Text generated by AI systems
    ├── gpt/              # OpenAI GPT-4 outputs
    │   ├── soft-skills-formal-es.txt
    │   └── remote-work-en.txt
    │
    ├── claude/           # Anthropic Claude outputs
    │   ├── ai-impact-en.txt
    │   └── blockchain-es.txt
    │
    ├── gemini/           # Google Gemini outputs
    │   ├── pm-methodologies-en.txt
    │   └── sleep-science-es.txt
    │
    └── mixed/            # Light/ambiguous AI patterns
        ├── leadership-light-en.txt
        └── time-management-es.txt
```

## Categories

### Human-written (`human/`)
- **Style**: Casual, opinionated, personal anecdotes
- **Characteristics**: Contractions, slang, imperfect grammar, first-person, humor, digressions
- **Expected Score**: < 25 (Mostly human-sounding)

### AI-generated (`ai/`)
- **Subcategories by source**:
  - `gpt/`: Over-structured, promotional language, chatbot artifacts
  - `claude/`: Philosophical, formal, exhaustive treatment
  - `gemini/`: Lists, headers, bullet points
  - `mixed/`: Light AI patterns, code-switching, hybrid quality
- **Expected Score**: 
  - Heavy AI: > 50
  - Light AI: 20-60

## Future Categories (Planned)

### By AI Involvement Level
- **Human-only**: Completely human-written
- **AI-assisted**: Human wrote with AI suggestions (light touch)
- **AI-edited**: Human wrote, AI edited/revised
- **AI-heavily-influenced**: Human prompt, AI drafted most content
- **AI-generated**: Complete AI output

### By Text Type
- Technical documentation
- Academic writing
- Marketing copy
- Social media posts
- Emails
- Creative writing

## Adding New Samples

1. Place file in appropriate subdirectory
2. Follow naming: `{description}-{lang}.txt` (e.g., `api-design-opinion-es.txt`)
3. Update this metadata file
4. Add corresponding test cases in `tests/suite.test.js`

## Quality Guidelines

- Minimum 80 words per sample for reliable analysis
- Include variety of sentence lengths
- Avoid samples that are obviously spoofed (make them realistic)
- Document source (which AI model, if AI-generated)
